lines: Everyone, family meeting! I have a surprise. I turned all of us into cartoon characters!
Wait, what? Like, actual cartoons? With our faces?
Yes! Look at us. Same family, just drawn with a blue marker.
Hmm. Let me check one thing first... good, my tilak is still there. Continue.
Arre, my saree looks better in the cartoon. And no grey hair. I approve!
I look good! But only five poses? A hero needs at least fifty.
You have five poses and three mouths, Bhavishy. That is more range than you show at breakfast.
She is not wrong. At breakfast, you have exactly one expression. Sleepy.
And one dialogue. Mummy, five more minutes.
Okay, okay. But tell me honestly. In cartoon world, do I finally win arguments?
In cartoon world, you still lose. But now you lose in high definition.
Now listen. If this is my cartoon kitchen, I have one rule. Cartoon mummies do not wash cartoon dishes.
Deal! In our cartoon, the dishes wash themselves.
Then cartoon Bhavishy also does not study? Asking for a friend. The friend is me.
Cartoon Papa is still a doctor. If a cartoon gets sick, who will treat him? A cartoon doctor. Correct.
And cartoon patients must pay real fees. That rule is final.
Mummy is already the best businesswoman in this cartoon.
Wait, one problem. If we are cartoons, who is drawing us right now?
Whoever it is, tell them Papa needs a little less tummy, and a little more hair.
And tell them Seema has not aged since 1998. Draw accordingly.
Noted! All requests have been sent to the artist. She is me. I am ignoring half of them.
You know, I made these cartoons because our family is already my favourite show.
Every house has a show, beta. Ours just has better comedy.
Thank you, thank you. Autographs after the episode.
Papa, any final doctor advice for our audience?
Yes. Laugh every day. It is the only medicine with no side effects. And I do not even charge for it.
And eat your dinner before the episode ends. Cartoon food does not fill real stomachs.
So that is us. The Agrawal family. Same love, same drama...
...just a little more colourful now. See you in episode two!
